{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Cream structured blazer, tailored single-breasted cut, hip-length, oatmeal hex code #F5F5DC, wool blend.
Pencil skirt, knee-length with a straight hem, soft charcoal grey hex code #36454F, heavy crepe.
Silk blouse, classic pointed collar and relaxed fit, pale lavender hex code #E6E6FA, smooth silk.
Loafers, sleek low-profile design, dark brown hex code #5C4033, polished leather.
Thin gold necklace, delicate chain length, antique gold hex code #B8860B, solid metal.
This ensemble works perfectly for a workday at the office during autumn by adhering to the neat dress code while providing warmth against the cooler season temperatures. The structured blazer and pencil skirt create a polished silhouette that projects professionalism and authority in a business setting. Soft textures like the silk blouse and wool blend add visual interest without sacrificing comfort, ensuring she feels confident throughout the day."}
